nav.subtitle: Proxy Control Center
workflow.running_text:
Next, choose the applications that should use the proxy.

Select them from the process list, or drop an app or shortcut onto the window.
workflow.unapplied_text:
Click Save & Apply to use the new settings for future connections only; existing connections stay unchanged.

Hook or DNS changes require restarting and proxying the affected processes again.
workflow.steps:
1. Configure the proxy server

2. Start the proxy service

3. Choose applications to proxy

Choose Yes to save or No to discard the changes.
profile.delete_confirm:
Delete profile "%s"?

proxy.start_failed: The local proxy service could not be initialized.
proxy.start_failed_detail:
The local proxy service could not be initialized.

Details: %s
test.start_failed: The connection test could not start. Check the current network.
test.success: The proxy server is working correctly.
test.not_saved: Testing does not save the profile; the current settings are still unsaved.
test.not_applied: Testing does not apply settings; the running proxy still uses the previous settings.
test.not_saved_or_applied: Testing does not save or apply settings; the running proxy still uses the previous settings.
test.title: Test Current Settings
apply.saved_success:
The current profile was saved and applied to the running proxy. Only future connections use the new settings; existing TCP/UDP sessions stay unchanged.

Already injected processes still cache Hook/DNS settings. Restart and proxy those processes again after changing these options.
test.no_connection: Could not connect to the proxy server.
test.target_failed: The proxy server could not connect to the target server.
test.auth_unknown: The proxy server uses an unsupported authentication method.
test.secure_unavailable: The gonc TLS-PSK component could not be loaded or is incompatible with this version of Windows. The bundled secure component does not currently support Windows XP; plain transport remains available.
test.secure_handshake_failed: The proxy server was reached, but the gonc TLS-PSK handshake failed. Check the PSK, server encryption mode, and protocol compatibility.
dialog.unsaved_drop: The proxy is not running, so the dropped application was not started.
dialog.drop_invalid: The dropped target was not recognized or no longer exists.
dialog.drop_uac_cancelled: Windows permission confirmation was cancelled; the application was not started.
dialog.drop_inject_failed: Proxy injection failed. The target was cancelled instead of continuing without the proxy.
dialog.drop_elevated_failed: Elevated launch or proxy injection did not complete; the target was cancelled.
dialog.drop_launch_failed: The dropped application could not start. Check the file and its permissions.
